about: Dervo's Mac icon choices (beta.15, group 7). Settings > Preferences > App icon offers them in this order. A choice with a "tiny" source uses it for the 16 px bitmap only, where its small face loses detail. scripts/build-icons.py renders each one to <id>.icns here and frontend/public/app-icons/<id>.png, and scripts/build-docktile.sh copies the ICNS files into the Dock tile plug-in. backend/app_icons.py and src/app_icon.rs carry the same ids; test_app_icons checks they agree.

choices.name: Cream
choices.line: Today’s icon. Pine pebble on a cream tile.

choices.name: Forest
choices.line: The dark theme as a tile. Reads well on dark wallpapers.

choices.name: Meadow
choices.line: The pebble in the meadow from the opening screen.

choices.name: Peek
choices.line: The pebble up close, rising from the bottom edge.

choices.name: Crew
choices.line: Dervo out front with two helpers behind.

choices.name: Terminal
choices.line: Graphite tile, a prompt in the corner and a caret for a mouth.

choices.name: Pixel
choices.line: The pebble on a 16 by 16 grid. Crisp at every size.

choices.name: Night

choices.name: Clay

choices.name: Obsidian
